mechanism_narrative: The upward momentum in RETAIL_REC from -86.3 to -81.1 over the prior four weeks reflects progressive lockdown relaxation; this momentum continues, so mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising TRANSIT mobility signals increased willingness to leave home for non-essential trips; when TRANSIT crosses above -75.0, retail footfall follows, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -75.0 but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous recovery in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT creates a commuting-retail feedback loop; as workers return and transit use rises, retail-and-recreation activity increases over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: Both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Easing lockdown policy is visible in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS mobility rising; as restrictions lift, retail-and-recreation venues reopen and RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above -40.0 and PARKS rises above -55.0
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS cross the stated thresholds but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility means people spend less time at home; when RESIDENTIAL falls below 25.0, out-of-home activity accelerates and RETAIL_REC rises over the next week.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 25.0 but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than over the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Spring seasonal conditions raise PARKS mobility even under restrictions; increased outdoor activity spills over into retail-and-recreation trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility rises or stays flat but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: If reopening causes TRANSIT and WORKPLACES to recover strongly, authorities reimpose restrictions to prevent crowding; this policy reversal drives RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -70.0 and WORKPLACES above -60.0
failure_condition: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES cross the stated thresholds but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GROCERY_PHARM mobility signals consumers are re-engaging with in-person shopping; this habit formation transfers to retail-and-recreation, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM rises while RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.
